reasons.A: Short declarative sentences in the right register, but few verbless fragments and a flatter, even rhythm than the passage's clipped stop-start movement.
reasons.B: Closest sentence movement: dense verbless fragments and paired short beats, plain first-person stance with a dry concession ('I will not argue with that'), and no dashes or semicolons, as in the passage.
reasons.C: Clipped sentences and wry short turns ('Not hard.', 'But it is mine.') fit well, but its fragments are less frequent and it closes on a tidy recap, not on a small concrete beat.
reasons.D: Long, subordinated sentences joined with semicolons and 'rather than', in an explanatory essay register far from the passage's terse fragments.
